purpose: Shard-parallel, read-only and fail-closed extraction of the same proof-gate-compatible hash-only P1 molecule identity collection defined by the serial production-v2 extractor.
parallelism_boundary: One process validates and extracts one complete shard. No membership, reject, payload-index, LMDB, or record stream is split across workers. The parent alone performs global closure, SQLite uniqueness, BINARY sorting, and final publication.

contains: one canonical admitted identity JSONL per shard
global SQLite uniqueness and BINARY-sort database

required_invariants: The config binds this exact parallel extraction contract, the exact full-release manifest bytes and SHA-256, all three source contracts, the release ID, and the RDKit identity version.
The parallel extractor and imported serial validation core are byte-hashed before work and checked unchanged before publication.

The immutable source release is opened read-only; each LMDB is opened with readonly=true, lock=false, create=false. Workers write only their unique files in a new scratch directory and the parent writes only the new output directory.
The release and shard filesystem envelopes remain closed. All declared source artifacts are checked by complete bytes and SHA-256 in the worker and rechecked by the parent after all workers finish.
Top-level shard declarations, worker results, and result ranges must each be complete, unique, contiguous, non-overlapping, and cover the selected ordinal range exactly.

Membership, reject-ledger, payload-index, and LMDB streams remain in lockstep within each complete shard. Rejected members are validated and filtered; no reject may appear in scratch or final identity rows.

Every admitted LMDB value is independently decoded through the public non-executable v2 framing, including wire, block, logical-record, member, identity-spec, contract, release, harness, and RDKit bindings.
Unknown or excess LMDB keys and metadata fail closed. The admitted key set is closed by stream exhaustion and global duplicate member IDs fail at the parent SQLite primary key.
The parent re-parses canonical worker JSONL, verifies its bytes and SHA-256 before and after ingestion, and uses the unchanged serial SQLite BINARY writer for final ordering.
Any worker exception prevents creation of the final output directory. Partial scratch evidence may remain for diagnosis and is never interpreted as a passing extraction.
The emitted molecule_identity_rows.jsonl is bytewise invariant under process count. Receipt scheduling fields and timestamps are outside this core determinism boundary.
The extractor does not choose a P1/P2 overlap policy, downstream split policy, tokenizer policy, or training-admission decision.
not_an_admission: A passing receipt only establishes a source-bound identity collection for later overlap proof. P1 and P2 training admission remain false.
